alt: A gray-haired couple in their seventies at a worn wooden kitchen table; she lifts the lid off a steaming pot while he smiles at a plate of pasta, with daylight coming through the window behind them.
A smiling grandmother and her young granddaughter sit at a kitchen table with glasses of orange juice, croissants and a jar of jam.
An older couple walks side by side down a quiet, tree-lined road in warm evening light.
The yellow Roberto Clemente Bridge framed by flowering spring trees, with downtown Pittsburgh towers rising behind it.
Sunlit rooftops and chimneys of Pittsburgh's South Side Slopes hillside neighborhood in autumn, with the downtown skyline under a clear blue sky.
A row of red-brick rowhouses in Pittsburgh's Greenfield neighborhood with white-railed front porches, striped awnings, steep front steps and a small flower garden.
A pair of black reading glasses on a table beside an open ledger of papers, a pen and a calculator.
